description: An AI provider's key, pasted by your human on Gemmein's own one-purpose page — never in a chat. Answers one state: connected (the key works, with the model it answered as), connected_with_problem (the key is saved but the account has no credit, the model isn't available to it — naming the tool that uses it — or the provider was busy), waiting (the page's link: it opens the provider's own key page, then your human pastes the key; Gemmein makes one tiny test call before saving, and a key the provider rejects is never saved), broken (the key's last call was rejected — with a fresh page), expired, cancelled or revoked, or not_live. provider: openai, anthropic, google, replicate, fal, assemblyai, deepgram, elevenlabs, runway or openai-compatible (your human types the endpoint's address and its name on the page — you never choose where a key is sent; before saving, the page shows the host the key will be sent to). wait: up to 40 seconds, answering the moment it changes — send the link, then call again with wait: 40. env live: Live's key, which asks for the code Gemmein emails on the page. A pipeline on the founder's own server has no key — its tool takes a URL.

provider.description: openai, anthropic, google, replicate, fal, assemblyai, deepgram, elevenlabs, runway or openai-compatible
